svg.title: Blue Green Black Red
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Four 63 × 32 in panels in observed colour order, using the conservation essay’s suggested18 in intervals. Installation spacing varies; this study depicts one arrangement and has no asserted fixed overall width. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/FC.558.A-D/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
